sourceContext: Human explicitly authorized starting a new isolated ORCHESTOR task to modernize Costa Clean dashboard analytics. Planning evidence exists on planning/dashboard-analytics-v1 but implementation must start from current main and must not reuse the existing Implementar v3 lane.
objective: Implement Dashboard Analytics V1 as a modern, trustworthy, mobile-first business analytics layer inside the existing Costa Clean V3 Home/Dashboard, using real authenticated application data, the existing Costa Clean design system, isolated ORCHESTOR task execution, and an autonomous implement-test-review-repair loop. Stop before application publication, PR/merge or production deployment.
why: The existing repository already contains the financial/domain foundations and a completed strategic planning package. The user wants a more modern dashboard with professional charts while preserving operational usefulness and current security/business boundaries.
scope: Create or reuse the Costa Clean project registration in ORCHESTOR, but create a NEW isolated task lane workstreamId=dashboard-analytics-v1 with displayName=Dashboard Analytics.
Do not reuse the existing Implementar v3 thread, run, worktree or branch.
Create a dedicated persistent Codex thread named Dashboard Analytics when native naming is supported, otherwise persist/display that canonical name in ORCHESTOR metadata.
Create a dedicated isolated Git worktree and implementation branch from exact baseline main@40dcf41be59e8e384ee05c544d4af56747c488e0. Suggested branch: orchestor/dashboard-analytics-v1.
Fail closed before edits if the exact application baseline cannot be established or if the target worktree is not isolated.

Use docs/phases/dashboard-analytics-v1/** from planning/dashboard-analytics-v1 as planning reference only. Do not merge or base implementation on that planning branch because it contains unrelated historical changes.
Re-audit current main against the planning package before implementation and update assumptions when current code has changed.
Preserve V3 Home as an operational cockpit; analytics extends it rather than replacing it with a reporting-only page.

Implement a typed analytics foundation under the existing dashboard architecture, preferably src/features/dashboard/analytics/** plus V3 presentation under src/v3/home/analytics/** when current structure still supports that direction.
Primary KPI set: Facturado, Cobrado, Pendiente de cobro, Gastos.
Use explicit truthful labels: Facturado and Cobrado are distinct; never use a generic ambiguous income label.
Do not introduce Resultado/Beneficio unless a separate canonical definition is explicitly authorized.
Do not introduce Vencido/Overdue without a canonical due-date contract.

Preserve existing application financial semantics unless a current canonical helper/test clearly supports a safer shared definition. Do not silently rewrite accounting semantics merely for chart consistency.
Use existing payment-state and outstanding-balance helpers/tolerance where applicable.
Implement one dominant temporal chart showing Facturado, Cobrado and Gastos across the selected range.
Implement period presets: 30 days, 3 months, 6 months, 12 months, current year and custom range, with Europe/Madrid business-timezone handling and valid previous-period comparisons.
When previous denominator is zero, avoid infinite percentage and use a truthful non-comparable state.
Implement invoice financial-state analytics using existing states: pending, partially paid, paid, cancelled.
Implement expense-category distribution from actual ExpenseCategory values. Prefer horizontal bars when category count/density makes donut charts hard to read.
Top clients may be implemented only when invoice inclusion semantics can be reused/proven without inventing business rules; otherwise leave it out of V1 and document why.
Client evolution may use Clientes nuevos by created_at only if current semantics remain truthful; do not create a fake historical active-client series.
Use real authenticated app data through current app-level/domain data paths. Chart components must not query Supabase directly.
Do not introduce mock production data.
Recharts is pre-authorized as the single new chart runtime only after local React/Vite compatibility and bundle-impact validation.
Do not add shadcn/ui, Tremor, Motion for React or TanStack Table as runtime dependencies in this task.
Use existing Costa Clean design-system primitives, semantic tokens, theme behavior, governed GSAP/reduced-motion infrastructure and 44px interaction-target rules.
Design target: modern/premium but not trading-like; clean hierarchy, restrained animation, semantic tooltips/legends, no default chart-library styling/palette leaking through.
Support loading, empty, zero, error, partial-data, unavailable and extreme-value states.
Mobile-first layout and QA across 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 820, 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 widths.
Support dark/light themes, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, touch interaction, textual/screen-reader chart summaries, reduced motion and no horizontal overflow.
Default to no database/schema/RLS/RPC changes. If measured implementation evidence proves a remote data-layer change is truly required, stop at a human gate rather than performing it.
Do not modify authentication, tenancy, permissions, invoice/payment persistence, fiscal-closing semantics, routes, production secrets or orchestrator core.
Add focused metric/date/series/unit tests, component/state tests and relevant authenticated local E2E/visual QA.
Run focused tests, full test suite, lint, typecheck, build, diff check, accessibility/responsive checks and current repository quality gates.
Use ORCHESTOR autonomous loop: audit -> plan -> implement -> verify -> review -> repair -> rereview -> recertify until local completion criteria are clean.
Repair safe local findings automatically within scope; routine test/review failures are not human gates.
At local completion, produce a factual final report and stop before git push/application publication/PR/merge/deploy unless separately authorized.
outOfScope: Reuse or mutation of the Implementar v3 task lane/thread/run/worktree.
Merging the planning/dashboard-analytics-v1 branch into implementation.
Any file or feature unrelated to Dashboard Analytics V1 except minimal package-lock/package dependency changes for authorized Recharts.
Forecasting, AI financial advice, trading/candlestick aesthetics.
New tenancy/role model or auth changes.
Supabase schema, RLS, RPC, migration or remote database mutation.
Secrets, DNS, billing, payments or external communications.
Application source push, PR, merge or release without later explicit approval.
Direct OpenAI API or OPENAI_API_KEY use.
acceptanceCriteria: Execution uses a new ORCHESTOR task lane named Dashboard Analytics, isolated from Implementar v3.
Implementation worktree and branch start from exact main baseline 40dcf41be59e8e384ee05c544d4af56747c488e0.
Planning branch is reference-only and unrelated planning-branch changes are not imported.
Home remains operationally useful and analytics is integrated into the existing V3 architecture.
Primary KPIs Facturado, Cobrado, Pendiente de cobro and Gastos have documented definitions and real-data selectors.
A period-aware temporal chart for Facturado/Cobrado/Gastos is implemented with responsive granularity and accessible summary.
Invoice-state and expense-category analytics are implemented truthfully using existing domain values.
No profit/result or overdue metric is invented.
No direct Supabase calls exist inside chart/presentation components.
Recharts is the only new chart runtime dependency if dependency validation passes.
No second design system is introduced.
Required responsive widths, dark/light, reduced motion, keyboard/focus and no-overflow checks pass.
Focused tests and full tests pass.
Lint, typecheck, build and diff checks pass.
Review/review-repair cycle completes with no unresolved correctness/security findings inside scope.
No application push, PR, merge or deployment occurs.
Final state is LOCAL_COMPLETE / PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED rather than production release.
requiredApprovals: Any application git push or GitHub publication.
Any Vercel deployment or Production access.
Any Supabase/remote database mutation or migration.
Any product semantic change that materially changes existing accounting behavior rather than presenting existing semantics.
Any material expansion outside Dashboard Analytics V1.
stopConditions: Project identity or exact main baseline cannot be proven.
Task lane/worktree/thread isolation from Implementar v3 cannot be proven.
The planning branch would need to be merged or unrelated historical files imported.
A financial semantic conflict cannot be represented truthfully without changing accounting behavior.
A dependency beyond Recharts becomes required.
Tests/lint/typecheck/build cannot pass without broad unrelated refactor.
Autonomous no-progress guard is exhausted with unresolved correctness/security findings.
verificationRequirements: Prove main baseline SHA and isolated task worktree/branch before edits.
Prove Dashboard Analytics has its own persistent Codex thread/run and Implementar v3 remains untouched.
Re-read current main and the planning package before implementation.
Record metric contracts and data sources used.
Record Recharts compatibility and bundle delta if installed.
Run lint, typecheck, build and diff check.
Run at least one independent review and automatic repair/rereview loop when findings exist.
Verify changed functional paths are within Dashboard Analytics scope plus authorized package files.
Publish final LOCAL_COMPLETE report with remaining publication gate.
